A photorealistic live-action educational video in one uninterrupted continuous take. The woman exactly matches the reference image, preserving the same facial identity, facial proportions, eye shape, hairstyle, overall hair silhouette, clothing, skin tone, and body proportions throughout the entire video.

Use the reference image as a strict visual template for the entire scene. The desk and background remain completely static and visually locked to the reference image. Preserve every wall, piece of furniture, decoration, object, edge, texture, pattern, color, shadow, reflection, and spatial relationship in its original position, scale, shape, and appearance. The background behaves like a fixed photographic plate and remains unchanged from the first frame to the last frame.

A completely locked eye-level camera captures a stable frontal upper-body medium shot. The camera position, viewing angle, focal length, framing, subject scale, perspective, and composition remain constant. The woman sits upright but relaxed behind the desk, with her body centered, her head facing directly forward, and her chin remaining level.

She maintains uninterrupted direct eye contact with the exact center of the camera lens throughout the entire take. Both eyes remain naturally aligned toward the lens, with a steady forward gaze and stable head direction while speaking and during every pause.

She gives a calm, friendly, and professional educational explanation with a subtle natural smile, gentle breathing, occasional natural blinking, and minimal upper-body movement. Her movement is limited to natural lip and jaw motion, subtle facial muscle movement, gentle breathing, and occasional blinking. Her mouth movement is restrained, realistic, and precisely synchronized to the provided audio.

Both hands rest calmly and visibly on the desktop throughout the video. The hands remain below chest level, away from the face, and mostly still. Each hand maintains realistic anatomy, stable proportions, matching skin tone, and exactly five naturally formed fingers.

During speech pauses, she continues looking directly into the camera lens. Her head, gaze, pose, hands, identity, position, framing, desk, and background remain unchanged. Her lips close naturally while only subtle breathing and occasional blinking continue.

Her hair appears naturally soft, light, airy, and slightly voluminous, with a gentle fluffy texture and subtle separation between individual strands. The hairstyle maintains its original shape, length, and overall silhouette. Only a few fine strands along the outer edges show barely perceptible natural micro-movement, while the main body of the hair remains stable and softly settled. Her face remains fully visible and unobstructed.

The original lighting, exposure, white balance, shadows, reflections, and colors from the reference image remain fixed and consistent. All visible motion is limited to the woman, while the desk, furniture, objects, walls, decorations, and entire background remain perfectly stationary. Realistic skin texture, clear natural eyes, stable facial and hand anatomy, smooth restrained motion, accurate lip synchronization, strong temporal consistency, and an unchanged composition throughout the entire video.
